scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS) / CSC Type A - Embassy of China in Bangladesh
scholarships.degree: Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, One-Year Chinese Language Program
scholarships.official_source: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Bangladesh

existing.description: The Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Bangladesh invites Bangladeshi students to apply for the Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS) - Type A, administered by the China Scholarship Council. The award covers study at Chinese universities in Bachelor's, Master's, Doctoral (PhD) and one-year Chinese language programmes. All applications are submitted online through the China Scholarship Council portal. The Embassy published the 2025/2026 call with a closing date of 10 January 2026.
eligibility: Applying to a programme at a Chinese university
Eligible degree level: Bachelor's, Master's, Doctoral (PhD) or one-year Chinese language programme
existing.eligibility_summary: Bangladeshi citizens applying to a Chinese university programme at Bachelor's, Master's, Doctoral or one-year Chinese language level.
benefits: Monthly living allowance (approximately CNY 2,500-3,500 depending on programme level)
application_method: Online application through the China Scholarship Council portal at www.campuschina.org
existing.duration: Duration of the degree program or one year for language program
existing.application_period: Announcement published 2025-12-19 with a 2026-01-10 closing date; applications for the following cycle are expected to be announced on the same annual cycle.
existing.deadline_display: The Embassy set "Application Deadline: January 10, 2026" for the 2025/2026 cycle; that date has passed and no next-cycle date has been published on the Embassy site.
